method: Read-only connector migration/table/advisor/deployment metadata. No execute_sql, data writes or deployments.

tables.name: public.scope_continuity_decisions
tables.comment: Deterministic Scope Continuity decisions derived from recorded declaration, authority and attestation inputs.

tables.name: public.evidence_nodes
tables.comment: Tenant-bound, normalized Evidence Graph nodes. Raw provider payloads remain in their authoritative stores.

tables.name: public.identity_confidence_results
tables.comment: Provisional identity confidence. It is not an authorization decision.

tables.name: public.ori_inference_records
tables.comment: Sanitized ORI shadow evidence only. Raw passports, biometrics, images, documents, provider payloads, email addresses, secrets, tokens, and arbitrary customer text are prohibited.

tables.name: public.public_api_outcome_submissions
tables.comment: Outcome assertions projected onto existing canonical transactions. AGENT_ASSERTED is never independent destination evidence.

tables.name: public.identity_signal_evidence
tables.comment: Normalized identity signal evidence only; raw provider proofs and secrets are prohibited.

tables.name: public.operational_entity_manifests
tables.comment: Versioned, signed manifests for canonical Operational Entities. No private credentials are stored.

tables.name: public.api_keys
tables.comment: Tenant-scoped external API client credentials. key_hash stores a salted scrypt derivation; plaintext secrets are never persisted.

tables.name: public.release_evidence_checks
tables.comment: Target-environment evidence references; source inspection alone must be blocked, not passed.

tables.name: public.consent_tracker_catalogue
tables.comment: Unknown trackers remain unclassified and cannot default to Essential.

tables.name: public.provider_transitions
tables.comment: Canonical provider-governance transition state with frozen historical evidence and decision snapshot references.

tables.name: public.trust_graph_relationships_v2
tables.comment: Versioned tenant-bound Trust Graph topology with non-destructive removal.

tables.name: public.controlled_destination_records
tables.comment: Safe internal destination A. Persistence is deliberately separate from trust-decision and enforcement evidence tables.

tables.name: public.operational_entity_authority_delegations
tables.comment: Signed, attenuated authority-lineage edges between canonical Operational Entities; identity remains separately proven.

tables.name: public.environment_attestations
tables.comment: Append-only attributed environment observations and assertions. Provider assertions are not independent evidence.

tables.name: public.external_action_outcomes
tables.comment: External action outcome ledger. UNKNOWN remains visible and may be followed by a later evidence-backed terminal result.

tables.name: public.native_enforcement_outcomes
tables.comment: Evidence-derived outcome correlation. ALLOW is never represented as proof of execution.

tables.name: public.canonical_trust_transactions
tables.comment: Canonical receipt index for one evidence-backed action transaction. Raw provider and action payloads are excluded.

tables.name: public.protected_workflows
tables.comment: Track + Block workflow state; not a Trust Object and not a decision engine.

tables.name: public.operational_entity_native_challenges
tables.comment: Tenant/entity-bound short-lived challenge metadata. Only the nonce hash is persisted.

tables.name: public.native_entity_identity_evidence
tables.comment: First-party cryptographic identity evidence. Provenance is CYBER_SENTINELS_NATIVE and is never independent corroboration of itself.

tables.name: public.webhook_event_ledger
tables.comment: Sanitized provider-neutral webhook intake ledger; raw payload retention is disabled.

tables.name: public.trust_signals
tables.comment: Immutable normalized trust signals. Raw provider payloads, secrets, biometric material, document images, full IP addresses and precise location are prohibited.

tables.name: public.release_validation_cases
tables.comment: Controlled licensed non-sensitive validation metadata; approval requires attributable review.

tables.name: public.external_action_acknowledgements
tables.comment: Transport acknowledgement only; acknowledgement must never be represented as an external action outcome.

tables.name: public.consent_receipts
tables.comment: Append-only, tamper-evident and integrity-verifiable Consent Receipts. Not described as immutable.

tables.name: public.operational_entity_external_identities
tables.comment: Append-only provider identity observations attached to an Operational Entity. Presence is evidence, not trust or authority.

tables.name: public.evidence_objects
tables.comment: Evidence Vault boundary: normalized facts may remain in-ledger; raw evidence requires an encrypted object reference and explicit access policy.

tables.name: public.trust_evidence
tables.comment: Provider-neutral, append-only evidence attached to Trust Graph entities.

tables.name: public.subject_trust_state
tables.comment: Materialized read model. Only apply_trust_state_decision_v1 may change current trust state.

tables.name: public.enterprise_policy_governance_events
tables.comment: RC2 append-only policy approval, reviewer, evidence, authority, replay and rollback history.

tables.name: public.consensus_decisions
tables.comment: Append-only canonical decision lineage; subject_trust_state is only a materialized current view.

tables.name: public.judgeme_installations
tables.comment: Trusted Judge.me shop-to-tenant installation mapping. Provider API credentials remain server-only environment secrets.

tables.name: public.replay_events
tables.comment: Immutable Trust Intelligence replay chronology linked to evidence and trust updates.

tables.name: public.ori_model_registry
tables.comment: Governed server-side ORI model metadata. Client model upload and public activation are prohibited.

tables.name: public.incident_submission_packages
tables.comment: Immutable evidence packages. regulator_ready means internally prepared and approved, not legally sufficient.

tables.name: public.provider_relationships
tables.comment: Tenant-scoped provider roles and responsibilities referencing the existing provider_registry; not a provider registry.

tables.name: public.operational_measurements
tables.comment: Sanitized durable timings; raw requests, secrets, personal data, documents and biometrics are prohibited.

tables.name: public.trust_entities
tables.comment: Versioned Enterprise Trust Graph entities. Deletion creates a tombstone.

tables.name: public.trust_event_envelopes
tables.comment: Provider envelope metadata and SHA-256 request digest only. Raw payload retention is prohibited.

tables.name: public.normalized_identity_evidence
tables.comment: Provider-neutral evidence and raw-payload digest only; no raw identity provider payload or identity document may be retained.

tables.name: public.trust_drift_findings
tables.comment: Rule-bound drift findings; not an unstructured log and never an authorization authority.

tables.name: public.trust_alert_activity
tables.comment: Immutable tenant-scoped alert collaboration history for the Enterprise Trust Centre.

tables.name: public.continuous_trust_assessments
tables.comment: Immutable continuous assessment context linked to the authoritative Trust State decision.

tables.name: public.provider_registry
tables.comment: Governed provider metadata. Secrets remain in deployment configuration and are never stored here.

tables.name: public.ori_reviewer_outcomes
tables.comment: Immutable attributed reviewer outcomes. Records require governance approval before future dataset eligibility and never trigger online learning.

tables.name: public.trust_profiles
tables.comment: Immutable Trust DNA profiles. Dimensions explain trust; this table is not an authorization authority.

tables.name: public.provider_execution_records
tables.comment: Target-environment provider execution proof; Live requires a completed real record in the current environment.

tables.name: public.trust_signal_processing
tables.comment: Durable bounded-retry outbox for serverless Continuous Trust processing; it is not an in-process worker queue.

tables.name: public.trust_domain_versions
tables.comment: Canonical trust-domain schema registry. Registration is not a trust assertion.

tables.name: public.provider_change_events
tables.comment: Provider-governance history attached to affected Operational Entities and controls; it is not a provider registry.

tables.name: public.workflow_interventions
tables.comment: Downstream responses to immutable canonical ALLOW/REVIEW/DENY transactions.
